git archive <commit> is unpacked into a scratch tree and tools/guardpkg/build.py --source <tree> is run against it; the reported package_sha256 is the value. Built from the commit object, never from a worktree. Derived twice independently at that commit, once along the installer's own path and once through this engine, with the same result.

statement: Normative Quelle: DEC-061 — Erwartungswerte aus dem Commit (docs/governance/decisions/DEC-061-erwartungswerte-aus-dem-commit.md). Dieses Register fuehrt die deklarierten Erwartungswerte und ihre Ableitungen; tools/gates/expectations.py prueft sie gegen das benannte Commitobjekt.
